$comment: The render context for templates/zsh/.zshrc.j2. `required` is derived from the template body (every name it reads in a `{{ }}` or `{% %}` expression), not from the consuming role's variable set — the zsh_config role defines far more than these eleven, and copying that set would make this contract say nothing.
title: zsh/.zshrc.j2 — render context
description: Every value the .zshrc template reads. Path-valued names are absolute paths the consumer resolves on the target host; this repository supplies none of them.

STARSHIP_CONFIG.description: Absolute path to starship.toml (exported as STARSHIP_CONFIG).

OH_MY_ZSH_DIR.description: Absolute path to the oh-my-zsh clone (exported as ZSH).

COLOR_SCHEME_CURRENT_DIR.description: The runtime-owned current/ pointer directory; the template cats <dir>/colors.sequences. Absolute — a relative value would source a file that never exists.

NVM_DIR.description: Absolute path to the nvm clone (exported as NVM_DIR).

PYENV_DIR.description: Absolute path to the pyenv clone (exported as PYENV_ROOT). Read only inside the PYENV_CONFIGURED block.

PYENV_CONFIGURED.description: Whether the pyenv clone exists on the target; gates the whole pyenv block. Read as an `{% if %}` condition, so it is required even though it never appears in a `{{ }}` interpolation.

ZSH_SYNTAX_HIGHLIGHTING.description: Absolute path to the zsh-syntax-highlighting script. Empty string = plugin absent = block omitted; that is a VALUE, not a missing variable.

ZSH_AUTOSUGGESTIONS.description: Absolute path to the zsh-autosuggestions script. Empty string = plugin absent = block omitted.

ZSH_HISTORY_SUBSTRING_SEARCH.description: Absolute path to the history-substring-search script. Empty string = plugin absent = block omitted.

FZF_KEY_BINDINGS.description: Absolute path to fzf's key-bindings.zsh (distro-dependent). Empty string = absent = block omitted.

FZF_COMPLETION.description: Absolute path to fzf's completion.zsh (distro-dependent). Empty string = absent = block omitted.

x-render-contract.no_default_on_required: None of these names may carry a `default(` fallback in the template: a fallback turns a missing value into a silently wrong config (an empty include path is the concrete failure shape this contract exists to prevent).
x-render-contract.empty_vs_missing: The five plugin paths are required and may be empty. An absent plugin is expressed as an empty value by the consumer, which is why they are not optional: an OPTIONAL name can be absent, a required name with an empty string is a decision the consumer made explicitly.
